what: A rounded paper sheet (section) enters from the bottom of the screen tilted 7° and scaled .84, becomes upright at 1× when its top edge touches the top of the screen, and from the moment its bottom edge passes the bottom of the screen tilts the opposite way (−7°) and shrinks to .84 again, revealing the next sheet — one screen height each for entering and leaving, tied directly to scroll with no curve

options.rot: Tilt (degrees), default 7. At 0 only the stem remains
options.shrink: Share that shrinks, default .16 (→ .84x). 0 means tilt only
options.out: If “off”, it does not move on exit, default is “on”

from.where: index.html .g-s5 (journey sheet — original --s5rot·--s5off: enter s=(screen − top edge)/screen, exit a=(screen − bottom edge)/screen, rotate((1−s−a)×7°) scale(1−min(1, 1−s+a)×.16)) · .g-guilds-wrap (guild sheet — enters only)
